hero.description: Codex is OpenAI's coding agent. Orkestr runs the official Codex CLI with your ChatGPT subscription — in parallel with Claude Code.

install.title: Install Codex CLI
install.description: The official Codex CLI (npm package @openai/codex) is installed into Orkestr's tools folder. Nothing else on your computer is changed.
install.noNpm: npm was not found. Install Node.js (it includes npm) and check again.
install.wait: Downloading with npm — this can take a minute.
install.failed: Installation failed. Last lines of the npm log:

signIn.title: Sign in with ChatGPT
signIn.description: Codex uses your ChatGPT plan (Plus, Pro, Team…). The sign-in runs in the official CLI; Orkestr never sees your password or tokens.
signIn.terminalHint: Finish the sign-in in the terminal, then check again.
signIn.waitingBrowser: Waiting for the sign-in in the browser…
signIn.deviceStep1: 1. Open this page on any device:
signIn.deviceWaiting: Waiting for you to confirm the code…

errors.authRequired: Codex needs you to sign in with ChatGPT.
errors.usageLimit: The ChatGPT plan limit is reached. Codex continues after the limit resets.
errors.usageLimitPct: The ChatGPT plan limit is almost used up ({{percent}}).
errors.appServer: Codex could not start. Check the installation and press «Check again».

noProject.title: No project open
noProject.description: Open a project with a folder to chat with Codex about it.

noFolder.title: The project has no folder
noFolder.description: Codex works in the project's folder. Set the project folder first.

welcome.title: Codex
welcome.hint: Pick a saved chat on the left or start a new one.

empty.title: Ask Codex about the project
empty.description: Codex reads the code, runs commands and edits files — Orkestr asks you before anything risky.

approval.titleCommand: Codex wants to run a command
approval.autoDenied: Forbidden by Orkestr's safety policy — denied automatically.
approval.allowSessionHint: Allow this and similar requests until the session ends
approval.abortHint: Deny and stop what Codex is doing

sidebar.label: Codex chats
sidebar.title: Chats
sidebar.toggle: Show or hide the chat list
sidebar.empty: No saved chats for this project yet.

limits.label: ChatGPT plan limits
limits.title: Plan limits
limits.unknownHint: Codex CLI did not report the plan limits.

options.modelHint: Model used from the next message
options.effortHint: Reasoning effort: deeper is slower and uses more of the plan

modeHint.readOnly: Codex only reads the project; anything else is asked
modeHint.ask: Codex asks before every command and edit
modeHint.auto: Codex works in the project folder and asks only to go beyond it

composer.label: Message to Codex
composer.placeholderBusy: Codex is working — your message will be queued
composer.queueFull: A message is already queued — wait for Codex to finish or remove it.

slash.fork: Fork this chat into a new one
slash.compact: Compact the conversation to free up context
slash.status: Show the model, plan limits and tokens
slash.noThread: This chat has no saved conversation to fork yet.
slash.modelSet: Model switched to {{model}} from the next message.
